::: notes
"As the saying goes: standards are like toothbrushes. Everybody wants one. Nobody wants to use anybody else's."
1:20.
Everyone sorts their bricks their own way, and nobody adopts someone else's system. So datom doesn't ask you to sort: it keeps the set.
Every build records its exact pieces and its instructions, without anyone filing anything. You call `datom_write()` and `datom_read()`; the hashes, manifest, version log and parquet inside the box are datom's job.
Click: "datom is one proposal. If it only starts the conversation, that's enough."
The quote is often credited to Connie Morella (2006), but older versions exist; hence "as the saying goes".
:::
